comment: The suites scripts/db-conformance.mjs runs against a real database.
A part's named invariant suite goes in `invariant`; the conformance suites
its change affects go in `conformance`. Both are paths from the repository
root. The runner fails when a named suite is missing, when any test in one
of them is skipped, and when a run ends with zero tests having executed.
Filled from the L1-TENANCY and L2-AUTHORITY handbacks: the pooled crossover,
the prefix harness and L2's identity, delegation, comment, preset-plan and
settings suites are the invariants; the first three conformance suites are the
catalogue, wrapper and runtime-statement proofs. statement-log.test.ts is
a pure unit suite and must not be named (it moves the database counter by 0).
L3-SURFACE adds the surface-operations suite (task.comment, preset.plan, settings, audited reads, D06); L4-RUNTIME adds the gate and lease suites (G01-G04, G06, G07, W01-W06, I07).
L2-FIX adds the comment-type upgrade, the login-kind race and the preset family suites.

L3-PART-B adds the task-runtime suite (propose/decide through the envelope, replay, the G03 recorded refusal, the runtime-refusal rollback, the proposal projection) and the agent-path suite (I12, I07: the pre-pickup pair, the one-task ceiling, the decision exclusion, the handback settlement, the agent-actor audit). runtime-codes.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

L3-PART-B-2 adds the task-runtime-routes suite (the five routes and both prefixes over HTTP, the retained-report refusal, the in-process restart), the cli-reach suite (every declaration through the generated client) and the surface-reads suite (settings.read, session.capabilities, audited reads with a null subject, D06 on the read half); L4-RUNTIME-FIX's review-fixes suite (R1-R10 regressions on a real database) is named with it. handback-expenditure.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.
L4-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds the classifier-race suite (R1's executed two-classifier race) and the decision-abort suite (R2's forced post-write reservation refusal).
See docs/agents/database-conformance.md.

BOUNDARY-FIXES adds the four boundary suites (root rulings 1, 3, 4 and 5 and I14-SEAM U1: installed system-field keys at the top level, read targets and the task.board operand, the non-object-body admission refusal, effective-grant capabilities).

L5-PROOFS adds four acceptance suites (the generated exported-surface inventory, the six-role nine-case matrix, the protected set on three surfaces, the four-state predicate/RLS mutation proof); each runs in process against the real application. restart-and-expiry.test.ts is NOT named: its container-restart case is a guarded skip (L5_RESTART_CONTAINER_NAME, or the older L5_RESTART_CONTAINER=1) and the runner refuses a skipped test, so the coordinator runs that leg explicitly with the flag as its own step. world.ts, cast.ts, restart-harness.ts and role-case-*.ts are harnesses, not suites.

L3-PART-B-3 adds the settings-revision-routes suite (the two settings commands and settings.read by revision over in-process Hono), the envelope-faults suite (the omitted operationId and the two task.propose shapes over in-process Hono) and the settings-revision suite (the same three writes through executeCommand). handback-successor.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE adds the five lifecycle suites (cancellation closes delegation and run, stale-version handback refused with retained report, proposal/handback lock order, cancel race, authority-loss classification) and control-scope (cancel/restart authorised on their own target); W-SCHEDULES adds the W01 before/after-commit, W03 handback-versus-proposal, W05 competing-reservation and eight-hour heartbeat schedules through the real command entry.

PERSON-WORK adds person-work-http (EX-01 person pickup, renewal and handback on the person route, wrong-owner and lost-rights refusals) and person-work-schedules (grant.revoke against pickup, R5 fresh replacement, three competing claimants, an agent on a person's lease of its own task).

AUTHORITY-LOSS adds authority-loss-person-lease (grant.revoke classifies a person's own lease, write as work authority, the run back to planned, revoke responses listing classified holds, replay exactly once) and gate-reason-lineage (task.propose and task.restart answer a foreign and a fabricated lineage id byte-identically, audited at home).

PICKUP-REPLAY adds pickup-replay-lost-response (a lost pickup response replayed with the same derived credential and handles under current rights, lease and approval binding, no plaintext token or key bytes stored) and pickup-replay-keys (fixed HMAC encoding, keyring parsing and provisioning, rotation with retained read keys, closed failure on a missing key or corrupt metadata, legacy rows kept legacy).

DECISION-V3 names verified-decisions (the chain, payload and key checks on the proposal read) and decision-v3 (columns bound to the signed payload on v1, v2 and v3 with the unkeyed chain recomputed: a fabricated signer, a transplanted approval, every v3 field and link, the per-format signedFields label, and the pinned v3 bytes).

OWN-LEASE-SCOPE adds own-lease-record-scope (task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback authorised on the task their reservation or lease belongs to: a record-scoped writer works their own lease, the sibling task and a fabricated id answer byte-identically, the strand case renews and hands back).

CLI-ENTRY adds cli-process (the runnable command line as separate OS processes against the real apps/api/server.ts on a free port: the person journey with revisions checked in the database, board and people reads, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED, another business, an unknown verb with no request, the agent queue/pickup/heartbeat/handback with the saved delegation credential, a bare agent call, login's password grant, and the package script). cli-process-harness.ts is a harness, not a suite; mounted-cli.test.ts stays unnamed because it needs SURFACE_API_PORT.

Also named: statement-capture-full, the fourth conformance suite (T04 and M03 over every operation); restricted-calls and restricted-calls-prefixes (I06 and M02 at the full schema and at every prefix, on seeded rows); production-lookup (I14 on the shipped lockTask, mutated on a disposable source copy); operand-refusals, capabilities-shape, unproduced-reach, gate-expiry, decision-integrity-read, controls-revoke, controls-work, web-reads, expiry-bound and the two external-party suites (R4); gate-negatives, model-negatives and gate-not-found; identifier-negatives (foreign, fabricated and same-business refusals compared by status and raw response bytes) and audit-per-operation (I13 and I08, and a non-object body recorded as one authentication_attempts row with no audit_events row, on both prefixes); authority-loss-narrowed, runtime-residuals and lease-held-reach.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-B adds l6-schedules (W02 b same-operationId pickup retry in flight, W04 pickup x task.cancel both orders and pickup x expired-lease replacement, each on two backends with observed parking), l6-cases (G04 superseded hold not claimable, G05 rulings 3 and 4, W05 BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE), restart-expiry-bound (task.restart at and one over seven days through the route) and heartbeat-bound (W02 c, the heartbeat maximum and one over).

Not named: tests/api/server-onerror.test.ts and tests/cli/mounted-cli.test.ts skip every case unless SURFACE_API_PORT names a spare loopback port for the real server they spawn, and the runner refuses a skip, so each runs as its own step with the port set.

G3-CASES adds grant-chain (a two-level manager chain through the grant writer: GRANT_WIDENS, GRANT_DEEPENS, and grant.revoke on the root biting the grandchild's next call beside a live sibling chain), agent-bare-handback-replay (a credential-free task.handback replay refused DELEGATION_EXCLUDES_OPERATION with nothing of the receipt and no state change) and decision-never-delegated (delegations_never_decide and the not-null decided_by_person_id, as the application role).

L3-RETENTION adds purge-retention (task.purge reads each business's retention_window_days inside its own transaction: two businesses with different windows and trash an hour either side, evidence untouched, a caller olderThanDays of any value refused COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with no mutation and one refused audit row, replay of an applied purge, a window of zero purging one business's trash only).

ID-OPERANDS adds id-operand-shape (a malformed id, "" and "not-a-uuid", against a fabricated uuid for every id operand on both prefixes: agent task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback answer the fabricated refusal byte for byte instead of the uuid fault, person task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback in the operation's own code, one refused audit row and no state change for each form, a numeric agent reservationId, and a valid pickup as the positive control).

PROOF-CLOSURE names d06-generated (D06 on the API, CLI and web person surfaces, every cell between a succeeding positive control and a succeeding clean retry, the person's own pickup, renewal and handback included) and d06-agent (D06 on the agent route).

AGENT-BOUNDARY adds agent-capabilities-intersection (agent session.capabilities reports the current intersection of purpose and the delegating person's effective grants: write absent once its grant expires, DELEGATION_NARROWED when nothing is held, and a replay under another delegation's credential never releases the first scope) and historical-handback-intake (a superseded or expired agent's new handback keeps one retained handback_reports row and one refused audit row and still answers DELEGATION_NOT_LIVE; wrong lease, fence or credential retain nothing; settled replay stays the replay), and names the existing capabilities-contract and agent-system-fields suites.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-A adds wrapper-mutation (T04 a and b: database.ts:105 made session-wide and moved before begin on a source copy, each red on the capture shape of real operations beside the unmutated copy; T04 c: the DECISION_INTEGRITY read captured as begin, local setting, work, rollback; T05: the session-wide mutant red at pooled-crossover's :168 and :206 reads, green on the restored wrapper), decision-signature-only (G02 a: only gate_decisions.signature altered, with and without the unkeyed chain recomputed, faults DECISION_INTEGRITY; restored, it reads) and decision-seq-race (G02 b: two approvals with room, parked on the chain lock on two backends, land at consecutive seq each linked to the row before).

RECOVERY-ENTRY adds recovery-entry (TC84/92 through the real apps/api/server.ts process with RECOVERY_BUSINESS_KEYS: an eligible recorded transition classified once before readiness, a second start subtracting nothing, an injected pre-commit fault rolled back with exit 1 and completed on the next start, claimable and unfenced-live holds untouched and a marked hold kept whole, only the configured business changed, two racing starts releasing each hold once).

AGENT-BOUNDARY-2 adds agent-pickup-payload (W02 a: person and agent pickup answers field by field against their rows, and the handbackShape derived from task.handback), and extends historical-handback-intake to a narrowed agent (DELEGATION_NARROWED keeps one retained report) with second-agent, cross-business, forged, lease, fence, replay and rollback controls on both paths.

ACCEPTANCE-ROWS names i10-inflight (I10: a read admitted and held open in its transaction while grant.revoke commits, then refused on the next call) and board-not-found (task.board on a foreign, fabricated or malformed board refused, never an empty success), the two suites L6 section 9 item 13 left unnamed for this lane; role-case-matrix now carries a named (c)/(d) row for all 35 operations and I07 on one live gate, and identifier-negatives the SC2 audit (9/9 at home, none in bravo). It adds identifier-timing (I04: 26 identifier-bearing operations, 30 alternating foreign/fabricated pairs after 5 discarded, Mann-Whitney |z| <= 3.29 or a median bound of max(2 ms, 20 percent), and a 15 ms injected delay flagged). cd-alternatives.ts is a harness, not a suite.
